segments.text: Hi! I'm Momo. Let's practice Hello, small talk..
segments.korean: 처음 만난 사람에게 질문하고 자연스럽게 대화를 마무리할 수 있어요.

segments.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
It was lovely talking to you.
I tried a new café near my place.
segments.korean: 집 근처 새 카페에 가 봤어요.

segments.text: Pretty good. I tried a new café near my place.
segments.korean: Jin: 꽤 좋았어요. 집 근처 새 카페에 가 봤어요.

segments.text: That sounds nice. Do you have any plans for next weekend?
segments.korean: Alex: 좋았겠네요. 다음 주말에는 무슨 계획 있어요?

segments.text: Not yet. Do you have any recommendations?
segments.korean: Jin: 아직요. 추천해 주실 만한 게 있나요?

segments.text: Remember this expression. How was your weekend?
segments.korean: How was your weekend?는 부담 없이 일상 이야기를 시작하는 질문입니다.

segments.text: Great job! Pause, repeat, and make it your own. See you in the next lesson!
segments.korean: 질문 뒤에는 내 이야기도 한 문장 덧붙여 보세요. 상대가 답할 여유를 주면 대화가 자연스럽게 이어집니다.
